title: French Hazelnut Chicken Tagine
description: A classic tagine dish from French cuisine, made with chicken and hazelnuts in a rich and aromatic sauce.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the chopped hazelnuts and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the Mediterranean tagine spice mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return the chicken to the pot and cover with a lid.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 25-30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the honey.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
